question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Ablaze
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ablaze"** means something that is on fire or very bright and full of light. (जलता हुआ, प्रज्वलित)

 
 
• **Example: **The forest was **ablaze** with hundreds of small fires.
 
 
 
• **"Burning"** refers to something that is on fire or very hot. (जलता हुआ)
 
 
• **Example: **The campfire has been **burning **for hours.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Ablaze' **is **'Burning'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Brazen **(ढीठ): Bold and without shame.

 
 
• **Example:** His **brazen** disregard for the rules shocked everyone.
 
 
 
• **Extinguished **(बुझा हुआ): Cause (a fire or light) to cease to burn or shine.
 
 
• **Example: **The fire was quickly **extinguished **by the firefighters.
 
 
 
• **Sharp** (तेज): Having an edge or point that is able to cut or pierce something.
 
 
• **Example:** The knife was **sharp** enough to slice through the bread easily.
